exams.name: Examination in fundamental engineering subjects (FE / Engineer-Intern exam)
exams.notes: Passing this exam qualifies the applicant as an engineer-intern. A separate professional engineer examination is also required for PE licensure.
exams.quote: each applicant for licensure shall submit to an examination by the State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors and, if found to be qualified, shall be registered, depending on his or her education and experience, either as: (1) A professional engineer; or (2) An engineer-intern.

required.quote: An application for renewal of a certificate of licensure shall be accompanied by evidence documenting the completion of acceptable continuing education credit during the previous renewal period.

available.quote: The State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors in its discretion may waive examination of a person applying to be licensed as an engineer or an engineer-intern if he or she is licensed either as an engineer or an engineer-in-training or an engineer-intern by the licensing authority of any state or territory or possession of the United States or of any foreign country

requirements.value: The board may waive examination if the applicant's qualifications at the time of original licensure in another state/territory/country are not less than those required under Arkansas law. Applicants may also obtain a temporary permit while applying for reciprocal or comity licensure.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The practice or offer to practice for others, as defined in § 17-30-101, by individuals licensed under this chapter through a firm is permitted if ... the firm has been issued a certificate of authorization by the State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors under this subchapter.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means a service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge in the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of engineering works and systems relating to the use of air, land, water, municipal and regional planning, forensic services, engineering teaching of advanced engineering subjects or related courses, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction to assure compliance with drawings and specifications that are related to public or private service or work, concerning any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems, or projects including architectural work that is incidental to the practice of engineering.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering" means a service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge in the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of engineering works and systems

methods_authorized.quote: consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of engineering works and systems relating to the use of air, land, water, municipal and regional planning, forensic services, engineering teaching of advanced engineering subjects or related courses, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction to assure compliance with drawings and specifications

covers_land_surveying.quote: State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer-intern" means a person who under this chapter has: (A) Qualified for an examination authorized by the State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors in fundamental engineering subjects; and (B) Passed the examination

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: In its discretion, the State Board of Licensure for Professional Engineers and Professional Surveyors may consider satisfactory graduate study in engineering equal to one (1) year's experience.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct control of, supervision of, and legal responsibility for all engineering work performed.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Require that plans, specifications, plats, and reports issued by a professional engineer are stamped with a board-authorized design seal.

seal_document_types.quote: plans, specifications, plats, and reports issued by a professional engineer are stamped with a board-authorized design seal

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The practice or offer to practice for others, as defined in § 17-30-101, by individuals licensed under this chapter through a firm is permitted if: (A) The professional engineers of the firm are licensed under this chapter or are practicing under § 17-30-105; and (B) The firm has been issued a certificate of authorization

value: Practice of any other legally recognized profession
Nonresident engineers legally qualified in their own state or country (temporary permit)
Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer, not making final engineering designs or decisions
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not prevent the practice by: (1) Other Professions. The practice of any other legally recognized profession; (2) Temporary Permits. ... (3) Employees and Subordinates. The work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a certificate of licensure under this chapter ... if the work does not include final engineering designs or decisions and is done under the direct supervision of and verified by a person holding a certificate of licensure

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board shall adopt rules of professional conduct under § 17-30-203 that shall be published in writing to an applicant for licensure under this chapter and published in the roster.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Five (5) members shall be professional engineers of at least ten (10) years' active experience, of good standing in their profession, and licensed as professional engineers at the time of their appointments.

retired_status_license_available.quote: A professional engineer or engineer-intern licensed under this chapter who is not engaged in the practice of engineering may request that the board grant him or her inactive status by placing his or her name on the board's inactive roll.
